description: Implementation of time-related functions for Windows, including gettimeofday, clock_gettime, and gmtime_r, with cross-platform considerations.

methods.name: gettimeofday
methods.description: Retrieves the current time of day, converting Windows system time to Unix epoch.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Provides clock time for CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC on Windows.

methods.name: gmtime_r
methods.description: Converts time_t to tm structure in a thread-safe manner using Windows gmtime_s.
